messages:

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-02-05T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 and retention requirements - call follow-up

Thanks for the call today - summary below.

Pain points:
- Need evidence for SOC 2 during vendor selection (audit logs, pen test report, DPA in place).
- Data retention policy must allow 7 years for certain PHI-adjacent logs.
- Concern about multi-tenant isolation and key management.

Goals:
1) Confirm Redwood's SOC 2 scope and where audit logs / access logs are retained.
2) Confirm DPA language around data processing and subprocessors.
3) Understand options for longer retention and export tooling.

Next steps from our side: please share SOC 2 summary, typical retention options, and a stub of pen test evidence/summary and how KMS integration works.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Security, Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-05T18:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 and retention requirements - call follow-up

Hi Alex - great to meet today. Recap and next steps below.

Recap / pain points you confirmed:
- Requirement for SOC 2 Type II coverage for data access and vendor controls.
- Need for accessible, immutable audit logs for up to 7 years for compliance team.
- DPA must include specific deletion and export guarantees and subprocessors list.
- KMS/HSM integration required for customer-managed keys for production data.

What Redwood provides (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood scope: control environment, access controls, logging and monitoring). I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and the standard pen-test evidence stub.
- Audit logs: fine-grained API and admin logs stored in immutable storage; retention configurable (default 90 days, configurable to multi-year with log export).
- DPA: standard DPA with addendum options; we support custom clauses in enterprise contracts.
- KMS: integrations with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and support for HSM-backed keys for private deployments.

Concrete next steps:
1) I'm attaching the SOC 2 summary and a pen-test evidence stub for your team to review. (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, pen-test-evidence-stub.txt)
2) Dylan will follow up with technical details on audit-log export formats and a sample retention/export playbook by EOD 2026-02-06.
3) Evelyn will loop in Legal to surface our DPA and comment on any required DPA addenda; expect initial redlines within 5 business days.
4) If you want, we can schedule a deep-dive on KMS integration next week - propose Tue/Thu.

Let me know if I missed anything. Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Alex - attaching the audit-log export spec and sample retention playbook.

Key points:
- Exports are JSONL or Parquet, include per-request metadata, timestamps, and immutability seals.
- Retention tiers: 90d default, 1y, 3y, 7y with automated cold storage and restore workflows.
- For 7y retention, we suggest weekly manifests + integrity hash (SHA256) for compliance audits.

Attachments: audit-log-export-spec.pdf (stub), retention-playbook.md (stub)

Happy to walk through specifics on a technical call.

-Dylan
